appliedUpdates.description: Document app/src/ module pattern: new modules use `use crate::*` to access statics (channels, counters, FIRMWARE_VERSION, DIAGNOSTICS_START_SECS) and utility functions (uptime_secs, init_heap) defined in main.rs.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature cleanup-app-xtask worker discovered that cargo +esp check warns about dead code for config.rs and crypto.rs functions that are used behind feature gates. The worker correctly identified these as pre-existing and not safe to remove.
